Container.Name: flint
Container.Overview: Flint is a local-first personal AI skills asset manager. Collect, tag, deduplicate and distribute SKILL.md directories across your AI agents and projects from one local web UI. Everything runs on your server; no cloud, no account, no telemetry.
Container.Description:
## Flint — local-first AI skills hub
Flint centralizes the skill directories used by your agents so you stop rewriting the same skill for every tool. Skills stay plain `SKILL.md` folders on your own disk — open, edit, diff and version them with git at any time.
### Features - **Library** — browse, search and preview every skill from registered repositories. - **Repositories** — register your own vault or third-party sources (read-only / linked). - **Tags & deduplication** — tag skills, stage metadata, merge same-named duplicates. - **Agents** — one card per real agent skills directory; symlink or copy deployment. - **Presets** — bundle skills plus tag matches and apply them to an agent in one click. - **Projects** — register a project, sync matched skills into `.agents/skills`. - **Health** — six-dimension checkup with one-click fixes.
### First run On first start the container installs `flint-skills-hub` from npm into `/config`, then serves the web UI on port **8787**. Internet access is required only for that initial install (and for updates). Config, logs and the npm install persist in the appdata path, so later starts are fast and offline.
### Paths | Container | Host default | Purpose | |---|---|---| | `/config` | `/mnt/user/appdata/flint` | config.json, logs, npm install |
Open the WebUI from the Docker tab or browse `http://<server-ip>:8787`.
### Support Report issues upstream at https://github.com/lcy362/flint/issues
